stem: In plants and humans, the phenotype of an organism is determined by the genotype and the environment.

parts.label: (a)
(a)(i)
parts.text: State which of the genotypes shown in Fig. 3.2 have blue petals.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: State the ratio of non-blue to blue petals for the cross shown in Fig. 3.2.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: Name the type of gene interaction that has caused the offspring ratio you have stated in (a)(ii).

parts.label: (a)(iv)
parts.text:
Gene $T/t$ and gene $D/d$ code for proteins that are involved in the control of the production of malvidin.

Discuss the possible roles of the proteins coded for by gene $T/t$ and gene $D/d$ in the control of the production of malvidin.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Some humans have the inherited condition haemophilia.

Explain the relationship between the $F8$ gene, factor VIII and the condition haemophilia.
